principles.name: Typed decision readout
principles.structure: Local LLM relation execution and trace
principles.finding: Fast and structurally reliable here; no overall semantic-quality gain.
principles.limitation: Same-case meaning accuracy and refusal-aware proper scores.

principles.name: Outcome-fitted probability assessment
principles.structure: Version-bound prediction assessment in the same semantic graph loop
principles.finding: Overconfidence shrank; direct probabilities remain worse than p=0.5.
principles.limitation: Independent outcomes, held-out calibration, drift and causal-credit separation.

principles.name: Shared-state computation
principles.structure: Snapshot-bound scheduling of dependency-free local LLM reads
principles.finding: Serial latency does not establish shared-trunk or parallel-head gains.
principles.limitation: Preserve dependencies and serializable revisions; compare actual shared compute at equal quality.

principles.name: Dynamic candidate and read construction
principles.structure: Role-bearing relation proposals and local read scope
principles.finding: Fixed binary support and no-op proposals do not discover relations.
principles.limitation: Candidate recall, none/expand, context sufficiency and fixed-topology controls.

principles.name: Joint output-law preservation
principles.structure: Ordered n-ary role incidence and joint transition messages
principles.finding: Computationally independent questions do not imply statistical independence.
principles.limitation: Test exclusion/complementarity and higher-order response; do not multiply marginals without assumptions.

principles.name: Typed recursive composition
principles.structure: Cognition-bearing HSWM cells composing under the same Step/Learn
principles.finding: No measured two-scale closure or continuity.
principles.limitation: Preserve effects, rights, exit, lineage and calibration in concrete two-scale interventions.

papers.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
papers.role: Temperature scaling foundation, independent of Jev; not a guarantee of HSWM calibration

papers.title: Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
papers.role: Proper scoring foundation, not empirical calibration evidence
